title: Towards Merging-conditional Backdoor Unalignment against Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.14701v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model merging has become widely adopted for enhancing the task-specific performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) without additional training. While the specialized model from third-party platforms may undergo safety audits (e.g., backdoor detection), we reveal a novel and critical threat: One-sided Merging-Conditional Backdoor (OMCB). OMCB remains dormant and undetectable within one standalone model but activates upon merging, triggering safety unalignment. We first theoretically analyze the existence and geometric location of OMCB, revealing that the parameter shift crossing safety decision boundaries is the main cause of backdoor activation. Building upon this insight, we propose SMOKE, a meta-learning-based attack framework. translated_title: 面向大语言模型的合并条件化后门去对齐研究
translated_abstract: 模型合并已成为增强大语言模型（LLMs）特定任务性能的常用手段，且无需额外训练。尽管来自第三方平台的专业化模型可能已经过安全审计（例如后门检测），我们揭示了一种新颖且严重的威胁：单侧合并条件后门（OMCB）。OMCB在单个独立模型中保持休眠且无法被检测，但会在模型合并时被激活，触发安全去对齐。我们首先从理论上分析了OMCB的存在性及其几何位置，揭示出跨越安全决策边界的参数偏移是后门激活的主要原因。基于这一洞察，我们提出了SMOKE，一个基于元学习的攻击框架。SMOKE通过双层优化策略植入OMCB：内循环通过随机低秩初始化和有限步最大化来合成代理元向量，而外循环则优化……
tldr: 本文揭示了一种新型安全威胁——单侧合并条件后门（OMCB），该后门在单个模型中休眠且无法被安全审计检测，但会在模型合并后被激活导致安全失对齐，并提出基于元学习的双层优化攻击框架SMOKE来植入此类后门。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a novel security threat called One-sided Merging-Conditional Backdoor (OMCB), which stays dormant and undetectable in standalone models but activates upon merging to trigger safety unalignment, and proposes SMOKE, a meta-learning-based bi-level optimization attack framework to implant such backdoors.
